title: Regina Cassandra Says Dharma Dropped Her From Kesari Chapter 2 Promotions
excerpt: The actor, who played Akshay Kumar's wife in the Hindi courtroom drama, says her name was dropped without explanation and a song featuring her was released without tagging her.
body:
• Regina Cassandra told India Today that Dharma Productions dropped her name from promotions for the Hindi film Kesari Chapter 2, despite her prominent role as Parvathy Nair, wife of Akshay Kumar's Sankaran Nair.
  • She said a song featuring her was released without tagging her, and asked: "Is it because I am a South Indian actress?"
  • Her comments came while responding to Janhvi Kapoor's remarks about objectification in Peddi and Radhika Apte's account of a Telugu film, which she warned against framing as a North-versus-South divide.
  • Kesari Chapter 2 (2025), directed by Karan Singh Tyagi, is streaming on JioHotstar in India; Regina next appears in the Tamil film Mookuthi Amman 2.

What Regina Cassandra said

Actor Regina Cassandra has questioned why Dharma Productions did not promote her in Kesari Chapter 2, the Hindi courtroom drama in which she played a prominent role. In a conversation with India Today, reported by Bollywood Hungama, she said her name was dropped from the film's promotions without any explanation.

"The same Karan Johar, whose Dharma Productions film I acted in, decided not to promote me despite me playing a prominent role. My name was dropped from the promotions without any explanation. They released a song featuring me but did not even tag me. What am I supposed to call this? Is it because I am a South Indian actress?"

— Regina Cassandra, to India Today

According to The Hollywood Reporter India, she played Parvathy Nair, the wife of Akshay Kumar's Sankaran Nair, in Kesari Chapter 2: The Untold Story of Jallianwala Bagh (2025). She added that it remains unclear why she was left out of the promotions.

The wider debate she was answering

Regina was responding to a conversation about the treatment of women in Telugu cinema. Janhvi Kapoor had addressed backlash over her portrayal of Achiyamma in Ram Charan's Peddi on Koffee With Karan, acknowledging extreme objectification and saying she should have pushed back. Radhika Apte had recalled a Telugu film in which she portrayed a woman married to her maternal uncle, remarks linked to Nandamuri Balakrishna's Legend.

Regina said she has a problem when a North Indian actor speaks about South Indian cinema in a way that creates a North-South divide. She argued that actors who feel uncomfortable should consider saying no or walking away, rather than criticising a project years later, and she noted practical differences between industries, including bound scripts and shooting schedules in Mumbai compared with scenes sometimes arriving on the morning of a shoot in the South.

The film, and how to watch it

Kesari Chapter 2 is a Hindi-language historical courtroom drama directed by Karan Singh Tyagi and produced by Dharma Productions. Akshay Kumar stars as C. Sankaran Nair, with R. Madhavan as advocate Neville McKinley and Ananya Panday as Dilreet Gill; Regina Cassandra played Parvathy Nair. The film is a spiritual sequel to Kesari (2019) and is based on the book The Case That Shook the Empire. After its theatrical run, it began streaming on JioHotstar on June 13, 2025, in India.

Regina made the comments while promoting her next film, the Tamil devotional film Mookuthi Amman 2 with Sundar C and Nayanthara, headed for a November 6 release, according to The Hollywood Reporter India. Dharma Productions had not responded publicly to her remarks in the reports read for this article.
